Daymark 1.3.1 unifies Windows application icons.

- Installer, uninstaller, window, notifications and shortcuts use the same clock artwork.
- Versioned physical icon files refresh shortcut icon references during upgrades.
- Existing Daymark desktop shortcuts are updated on launch; deleted shortcuts are not recreated.
- Windows and macOS packaged launch checks run before publishing.
- Existing tasks and preferences remain compatible.

This release is unsigned. Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning; icon changes do not establish publisher trust. macOS is not notarized.
